subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should OpenClaw expose nonblank `agents.list[].description` values through the model-visible `agents_list` tool, and if so should that output be unconditional for authorized callers or narrowed/gated?
rationale: The remaining code change is small, but it changes a model-visible metadata boundary for operator-authored config, which repository policy treats as compatibility and security sensitive.

options.title: Accept Narrow Output
options.body: Expose trimmed nonblank descriptions only for configured agents already visible through `agents_list`, then refresh and review the linked PR for merge.

options.title: Gate Or Narrow Further
options.body: Require an explicit config or permission boundary before descriptions are returned by `agents_list`.

options.title: Reject Core Exposure
options.body: Keep descriptions as config-only metadata and close or supersede the linked PR in favor of a broader roster or plugin/API design.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Output
recommendation.body: Expose trimmed nonblank descriptions only for configured agents already visible through `agents_list`, then refresh and review the linked PR for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced `agents_list` and adjacent multi-agent config behavior, so he is the best available owner for the product boundary decision.
